metadata.question: Did more forest area burn in Sakha in 2015 than compared to 2021?

data.raw_code: To answer this question, I need to: 1. Define the Sakha region (Yakutia) in Russia 2. Get burned area data for 2015 and 2021 3. Compare the total burned forest area between these years I'll use the MCD64A1 Burned Area product which provides monthly burned area data. I need to: - Filter by the Sakha region geometry - Filter by year (2015 and 2021) - Sum the burned area for each year - Focus on forest areas (I'll need to mask to forest land cover) For forest masking, I can use MODIS Land Cover (MCD12Q1) to identify forest pixels. The logic: - If 2015 burned area > 2021 burned area: A (Yes) - Else: B (No) - Handle cases where data is missing or invalid ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
sakha = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [105, 50], [150, 50], [150, 75], [105, 75], [105, 50]
])  # Approximate Sakha Republic bounds

# 2. Data Acquisition - Burned Area and Land Cover
def get_burned_area(year):
    start_date = f'{year}-01-01'
    end_date = f'{year}-12-31'
    
    # Get burned area collection
    burned_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD64A1') \
        .filterBounds(sakha) \
        .filterDate(start_date, end_date)
    
    # Get land cover for forest mask
    lc = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD12Q1') \
        .filterBounds(sakha) \
        .filterDate(f'{year}-01-01', f'{year}-12-31') \
        .first()
    
    return burned_col, lc

# Process each year
years = [2015, 2021]
results = {}

for year in years:
    burned_col, lc = get_burned_area(year)
    
    # Check if collection is empty
    if burned_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        print(f"{year}: No burned area data")
        results[year] = None
        continue
    
    # Create forest mask (IGBP classes 1-5: forests)
    forest_mask = lc.select('LC_Type1').gte(1).And(lc.select('LC_Type1').lte(5))
    
    # Sum burned area over the year, masked to forest areas
    yearly_burned = burned_col.select('BurnDate').max()
    forest_burned = yearly_burned.updateMask(forest_mask).gt(0)  # Burned pixels
    
    # Calculate area in km²
    area_image = forest_burned.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).divide(1e6)
    
    # Reduce region to get total area
    total_area = area_image.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=sakha,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('BurnDate')
    
    # Get pixel count for validation
    pixel_count = forest_burned.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=sakha,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('BurnDate')
    
    area_val = total_area.getInfo()
    count_val = pixel_count.getInfo()
    
    print(f"{year}: {area_val:.2f} km² burned (Pixels: {count_val})")
    results[year] = area_val

# 3. Validation & Final Answer
if None in results.values():
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif any(v == 0 for v in results.values() if v is not None):
    # Check if valid pixels exist but area is 0
    pixel_counts = [forest_burned.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=sakha, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('BurnDate').getInfo() for year in years]
    
    if all(p == 0 for p in pixel_counts):
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif results[2015] > results[2021]:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
elif any(v is None or v < 0 for v in results.values()):
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif results[2015] > results[2021]:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
